description: React component 'MCPServerSelector' allowing users to select MCP servers and access groups. It fetches data asynchronously, manages selection state, and renders a customized multi-select dropdown with visual indicators for different item types.

methods.name: MCPServerSelector
methods.description: React functional component providing a multi-select dropdown for MCP servers and access groups, fetching data on mount and passing selected values via 'onChange' callback.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook that triggers data fetching when 'accessToken' changes.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Async function that calls external API functions to fetch MCP servers and access groups, then updates component state.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handler to update the parent component with the selected servers and access groups based on user selection.
